items.label: Catchment tint: fraction of civilian request supported
Circles: allocated resident scenario; dark centre: feasible cohort

reach_towns.note: Scenario: finite local cereal supports requested civilians and a resident institutional cohort in ONE repeating food budget. Only feasible affiliated cohorts emit two-way seasonal reach. Same candidates and transport in every case; no population-to-power multiplier. Proposed sites inherit painted-claim hypotheses; marked evidence takes precedence. Missing sources or local grain support do not prove empty land or lost sovereignty. Other staples, livestock food, maritime grain imports, water volumes and complete household/draft labour are not yet integrated. See the selected-site ledger and methods. Soil fertility: equilibrium wheat/barley grain from the Earth-tested soil-fertility state at the AD 200 non-fertilizer N input (27.5 kg N/ha/yr), 53.2% of the previous chain's cereal (cell factor median 0.34, 10-90% 0.19-1.52). Three-field rotation with bare fallow and no nutrient transfer; it keeps the Han AD 2 census fit and improves the 11-region Earth census check. Rothamsted soil assumed everywhere; rural food claims remain fixed. See reports/FERTILITY_INTEGRATION_20261106.md. Earth control test (reports/EARTH_CONTROL_20261106.md): staffs 40% of Rome's towns and 76% of Han's county seats; extent balanced accuracy 0.61 (Rome) and 0.60 (Han) against 0.82 and 0.70 for the transport-only map.
